assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
Given the history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to detect and characterize these paroxysmal arrhythmias in the setting of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
